entities.name: E. coli Proline/Betainetransporter P0C0L7
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt P0C0L7 and P0C0L8; 500 aa.
Proton-coupled symporter annotated to import proline and osmolytes including glycine betaine; reference annotations include additional compatible osmolytes.
Localized to bacterial cell inner membrane as a multipass membrane protein.
Associated reference GO processes include amino-acid transport, proline import, glycine betaine transport, and hyperosmotic response.

entities.name: Bacterial osmotic stress response
observations: The exact-match transporter is annotated as participating in osmolyte uptake and osmoregulation during hyperosmotic stress.
